tools.name: check_lookalike
tools.description:
Check whether one domain or Web3 name is a visual look-alike (homograph): letters from different scripts mixed in one label, or every non-ASCII letter having a Latin twin, so раураl.com reads as paypal.com. Returns the scripts used and the Latin name it imitates.

Use it to screen candidate or incom

tools.name: check_mail_security
tools.description: Grade one domain's email authentication and list every check: SPF (single record, the 10 DNS-lookup limit across includes, the all qualifier), DMARC (policy, inheritance from the organizational domain, pct, report addresses), MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, DANE and null MX. The level is strong, fair, weak,

tools.name: list_data_sources
tools.description:
List the local datasets and feeds behind lookup_target (RIR delegations, IANA, Public Suffix List, cloud / CDN ranges, Tor and Private Relay, reputation lists, GeoLite2) with state, record count, generation date and a stale flag.

Use it to judge how current a reputation, RIR, cloud or geolocation a

tools.name: lookup_target
tools.description: Look up one domain, IP address, CIDR block, ASN (AS15169) or Web3 name (ENS .eth, Unstoppable, SPACE ID .bnb, Handshake hns:) and get a compact fact sheet. Domains: registrar, dates, status, nameservers, DNS records, overall mail-security grade, third-party services seen in DNS, possibly dangling re

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_mail_security, list_data_sources, lookup_target · Private data: check_mail_security, list_data_sources, lookup_target · Public sink: check_mail_security, lookup_target.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_mail_security, list_data_sources, lookup_target · Private data: check_mail_security, list_data_sources, lookup_target · Public sink: check_mail_security, lookup_target

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
